hooks.logic:
If the current form of the enemy is "4", then
  Count up "doubleCancelTurn".
  If the count "doubleCancelTurn" is more than the numeric entry "double_cancel_turn" in the battle settings of the group of the acting enemy or not (the enemy has the DO_NOTHING_FOR_DISPEL status), then
    The enemy changes to form the script register's 'saveSuffixNo'.
    The enemy cancels its cast.
    Reset the count "doubleCancelTurn".
If condition flag "double_done" is up this frame, then
  Set the script register's 'saveSuffixNo' to the current form of the enemy.
  The enemy gains the DO_NOTHING_FOR_DISPEL status.
  The enemy changes to form "4".
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of the enemy and the current form of the enemy is not "4", then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

The enemy changes to form the script register's 'saveSuffixNo'.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
If the current form of the enemy is "4" and the unique id of arg's 'executer' is the unique id of the enemy and arg meets the move condition {isNormalRegistered: true}, then the enemy uses (the value "abilityId" of arg) immediately with options {skipStepCnt: true} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
